limitations: Tests do not certify extraction accuracy on arbitrary papers.
cache_regressions: verify outside ranges; audit outside contract; Excel error cache rejected; valid synthetic cache accepted
inventory_and_styles: missing whole series; duplicates; wrong identity; point gaps; same-color width binding; overlapping selectors; grid bundle rejection; border exclusion; real synthetic PDF CLI
filled_dashes: single quad/rectangle trace; local gap interpolation; capped stroke; ambiguity; missing data preserved; UTF-8 Chinese PDF path
scan_and_counting: short vector paths coexist with bitmap; overlap union area; numeric control glyphs in separate spans; numeric/blank/text/boolean counts

agent_review.scope: synthetic review-loop tests; includes coincident role routing and UTF-8 CLI
